# Gaṅgeśa Upādhyāya

*1300 – 1360 · Indian · [Nyāya](../movements/nyaya.md)*

Founder of "new Nyāya" (Navya-Nyāya), author of the Tattvacintāmaṇi, whose technical language became that of all Indian scholasticism.
